title: Grateful Dead Live at World Music Festival on 1982-11-26

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a high‑energy beach festival show with a smoking Fire on the Mountain and tight drums, overall solid performance.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its lively second set—especially a great Fire on the Mountain, tight drum section and strong vocal harmonies—while the first set offers pleasant moments despite a few less‑enthusiastic songs. The soundboard recording is described as clear with crisp vocals and no noticeable technical flaws, making the show enjoyable to listen to.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review gives a 4‑star rating; it highlights strong musical moments and a clear soundboard recording, but notes some songs that fell short, leading to an overall good but not exceptional score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer mentions crisp vocals, tight mix and no major drop‑outs or muddiness; the soundboard source provides clear instrument separation.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set moves through varied tempos and moods, while the second set builds tighter grooves with a strong synth‑driven climax, short drum/space segment and high‑energy finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals start weary on Althea but improve; delivers shredding solo during Fire on the Mountain.
band_member_comments.Phil: Very active on 'Women Are Smarter' with strong bass presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: His growl is missed on Throwing Stones; matches Brent on vocals for Not Fade Away.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's crisp synth work and aggressive climax praised; organ‑guitar harmonies noted as beautiful.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy and Mickey produce an almost tribal 5‑minute drum segment, highlighted positively.
